answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The tide is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the basalt. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
